verified: Verified: this result is signed by your lab.
carrier_intro: You carry a change in these genes. This usually does not mean you are ill.
none: No carrier changes were found in the panel.
notyet: Not quite. Read the card again if you like.
pair_help: Do this together, in person. You will both learn only one thing: whether you share a change in the same gene.
qr: Ask your partner to scan this code (valid 5 minutes, one use)
shared_yes: You share a change in the same gene.
shared_no: You do not share a change in the same gene.
reveal_info: Nothing is shown until both of you agree.
waiting: Waiting for your partner to agree.
none_perm: You have not shared anything. This is the default.
options: Your options are yours to choose, including continuing without any intervention.
scan_ok: Code read. Continue to the check.
scan_bad: That is not an AMANA pairing code.
scan_denied: Camera not available. Use the code shown on your partner's phone instead.
set_pin: Set app lock PIN (at least 4 digits)
lock_on: App lock is on. Your saved result is encrypted on this phone.
offline_copy: No connection. Showing the encrypted copy saved on this phone.
signin: Sign in with national digital ID (demo)
signin_note: Demo sign-in with a synthetic persona. Your result is then sent once to this phone and kept here, encrypted.
switch: Use a different demo persona (deletes this phone's copy)
only_you: Only you can see this. It is stored on this phone, not on our servers.
not_verified: The signatures on this result did not check out. Do not rely on it.
no_wallet: There is no result on this phone yet. Sign in first.
waiting_partner: Waiting for your partner to connect...
partner_agreed: Your partner has agreed to see the condition.
check_failed: The check could not be completed. Start again with a new code.
pair_privacy: Neither of you sees the other's results. The answer is worked out on your phones.
help_privacy: Nothing here is shared until you agree on the next screen.
sharing_privacy: Only you can see this list. Each change is signed by this phone.
settings_privacy: These settings stay on this phone.
promise: Understand your genetic result. Share only what you choose.
protect_1: Your result is sent once to this phone and kept here, encrypted.
protect_2: A check with a partner tells you both one thing only: whether you share a change in the same gene.
protect_3: The condition name is shown only if both of you agree.
protect_4: Nothing goes to a counsellor or anyone else unless you choose it, and you can stop it at any time.
signin_receives: AMANA receives a reference to your name and your test result. Nothing else.
persona_hint: Demo couples: Mariam + Khalid (private check), Noura + Omar (programme: compatible), Layla + Yousef (programme: not compatible).
signin_failed: Sign-in did not work. Please try again.
api_down: Cannot reach the AMANA service. Check that the demo API is running.
none_n: No carrier changes found among the {n} genes screened.
carry_one: You carry 1 change in a gene.
carriers_healthy: Carriers are healthy. Being a carrier usually does not mean you have symptoms yourself.
no_card_yet: An information card for this gene is being written.
prog_compatible_carrier: You are a carrier. Here is what that means for you and your family.
prog_compatible_none: No carrier changes were found for you.
prog_incompatible: You both carry a change in the same gene.
prog_incompatible_line: A counsellor can explain what this means and your options.
pending_review_why: This card is written from public medical sources and is waiting for a clinician to review it.
selected_note: Selected from the reviewed card, word for word.
diagram_alt: Four children of two carrier parents: one is not a carrier, two are carriers, one has the condition.
diagram_parents: When both parents are carriers of the same gene:
diagram_caption: This is the chance for each pregnancy.
tb_private: Your answers are saved without your name or any link to this phone.
tb_done: Thank you. You can read the card again at any time.
ask_note: Answers come only from reviewed cards and are worked out on this phone. Your question is not sent anywhere. AMANA does not tell anyone what to decide.
c_check_what: Only whether you share a change in the same gene. No gene names.
c_check_who: Your partner, on their phone, here with you.
c_check_long: This check only. The code works once, for 5 minutes.
c_check_undo: Close this screen at any time. Nothing about the check is stored on our servers.
qr_alt: Pairing code for your partner to scan
qr_why: The code expires to keep the check safe.
manual_code: Can't scan? Show the code as text
checking_line: Your results never leave your phone.
shared_yes_line: You can choose to see which condition. Both of you need to agree.
shared_no_line: This covers the genes on the screening panel.
reveal_ask: Show which condition? Both of you need to agree.
c_reveal_what: The name of the gene you share. Nothing else.
c_reveal_who: Your partner, and only if they agree too.
c_reveal_undo: Choose Not now. Your partner sees nothing unless both of you agree.
revealed_line: A counsellor can explain what this means and your options.
code_expired: The code has expired. Make a new one.
label_advice: Clinical advice, signed off by your counsellor
tier1_line: Read the cards for your result, or ask a question below.
tier2_placeholder: Write your question. Do not include names.
tier3_line: Talk to a counsellor in person or by video.
tier3_line_priority: Because you share a change in the same gene, a counsellor will see you within 48 hours.
family_line: Relatives may carry the same change. You can send them a general invitation, without your name.
study_link: Take part in the understanding study (5 minutes, anonymous)
scope_none: That you would like to talk (no result)
scope_prog_incompatible: Programme result: both carry a change in the same gene
scope_check_shared: Check result: you share a change in the same gene
scope_not: Not shared: your name, your other genes, your partner's result.
c_share_long: 30 days, unless you stop it sooner.
c_share_undo: Revoke it in Sharing. It stops at once.
booked: Booked. The counsellor can now see what you agreed to share.
question_sent: Sent. You will see the reply here.
slot_taken: That time was just taken. Please choose another.
share_failed: Sharing did not work. Please try again.
invite_explain: Your relative gets a link with general information about carrier screening. It does not say who sent it or anything about your result.
invite_text: Someone in your family thinks you may want to learn about carrier screening. Carriers are usually healthy. Knowing can help when planning a family.
invite_text_note: No name, gene or condition is included.
invite_counts: If they open it, AMANA counts it only in a total. You will not be told.
invite_revoke: You can cancel this link in Sharing.
invite_c_what: A general invitation. No name, gene or result.
invite_c_who: Whoever you send the link to.
invite_title: An invitation to learn about carrier screening
invite_no_sender: This invitation does not say who sent it.
invite_accept: I would like to learn more
invite_thanks: Thank you. You can ask your doctor or the premarital screening programme about a test.
invite_choice: This is your choice. Nothing happens if you close this page.
invite_gone: It may have expired or been cancelled. You can still read general information.
revoke_note: Revoking stops future access straight away.
delete_line: Remove your result from this phone and stop all sharing.
delete_1: Your result and keys are removed from this phone.
delete_2: Every permission is withdrawn straight away.
delete_3: Counsellors can no longer open your requests.
delete_cannot_undo: This cannot be undone. To use AMANA again, you sign in and your lab sends the result again.
about: AMANA demo. Synthetic people only. Not for medical use.
offline: You're offline. Your results are still here.
study_intro: We are testing whether AMANA explains a result more clearly than a lab letter.
study_p1: You read a short lab letter and answer 3 questions.
study_p2: Then you read the AMANA card and answer the same 3 questions.
study_p3: We save only your answers, language and reading comfort. No name, no device id.
study_agree: I agree to take part. I can stop at any time.
study_letter_note: This is an example letter. It is not about you.
study_card_title: The same result, explained by AMANA
study_thanks_line: Your answers help make results easier to understand for everyone.
ask_offline: Answers need the app to be opened once with a connection.
picked_model: Sentences picked by a small language model on this phone.
picked_rules: Sentences picked by word matching on this phone.
model_offer_title: Better answers to questions in your own words
model_offer_body: Download a small language model ({size}) so AMANA understands questions however you write them, in English or Arabic. It runs only on this phone, and your questions are never sent. Without it, answers still work by word matching.
model_mobile_data: Your phone seems to be on mobile data or saving data. The download is {size}. You can wait for Wi-Fi.
model_failed: The download did not finish. Answers still work by word matching.
model_ready: The language model is on this phone ({size}). Questions are answered here and never sent.
model_rules: Questions are answered on this phone by word matching. The answers are the same reviewed sentences.
model_unsupported: This phone answers questions by word matching, which needs very little memory. The answers are the same reviewed sentences.
codes_old: Your check codes are more than a week old. Renew them to do a check. Your result stays on this phone.
renew_failed: Could not renew the check codes. Try again.
partner_codes_old: Your partner's check codes are out of date. Ask them to open the check again and renew their codes, then make a new code.
